blurb: Bella Dance Studio offers dance classes including ballet, tap, cheer, jazz, hip hop, lyrical, and pointe for various age groups. Classes focus on technique, terminology, and recital performance. Adult classes are performance-only and taught in a relaxed setting.
extraNote: $50 costume deposit · Registration fees: 1st child $30, 2nd child $25, 3rd child $20 · Payments due by 1st of each month; $25 late fee after 10th; no attendance if unpaid by next month
